alt: The Golden Gate Bridge under a vivid sunset sky, with a section near the foreground where a brick building edge impossibly overlaps a rock closer to the camera
story: Apple's default Golden Gate Bridge live wallpaper for macOS 27 has a VFX masking error where a brick-walled building overlaps a foreground rock in a physically impossible way, turning Apple's 'it just works' promise into an internet detective mystery.
why_funny: The company that prides itself on obsessive attention to detail shipped an OS wallpaper with a glitched building that defies the laws of physics.
